providers.description: Lorillard Tobacco Company was the third-largest cigarette manufacturer in the United States, marketing cigarettes under brand names including Newport, Kent, True, and Old Gold. In 2015, Lorillard was acquired by Reynolds American Inc. (RAI), and its operations and brands have since been integrated into the Reynolds American family of companies. Lorillard does not operate a public developer program or API platform.

providers.name: Madison-reed
providers.description: Madison Reed is a female-founded and female-led direct-to-consumer hair color company offering 8-Free permanent, demi-permanent, and root touch-up hair color crafted in Italy, sold as at-home kits and delivered as professional services at 95+ Hair Color Bar locations across the United States. The company blends e-commerce retail, subscription replenishment, and in-person salon booking. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and True Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: McCormick
providers.description: McCormick spices and products have been kitchen must-haves since 1889. Learn about seasoning and cuisine while discovering tons of delicious recipes today. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: Miracle Miles
providers.description: Miracle Miles (Miracle Miles Group) is a consumer footwear e-commerce company backed by Hongshan (Sequoia China). It designs, manufactures, and sells affordable fashion footwear and accessories direct-to-consumer through a family of online brands, including DREAM PAIRS (launched 2009), Bruno Marc (men's footwear), Nortiv 8 (outdoor), and Dream Pairs Kids, selling primarily via its own storefronts and large online marketplaces. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile is maintained as a company/lead record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PPG Industries
providers.description: PPG Industries is a Fortune 500 global supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials serving customers in construction, consumer products, industrial, transportation markets, and aftermarkets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with PPG Industries. As of the last review, no public APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Rothys
providers.description: Rothy's is a San Francisco-based direct-to-consumer footwear and accessories brand founded in 2012, known for washable shoes and bags 3D-knitted from recycled materials such as post-consumer plastic water bottles and marine plastics. Its catalog spans flats, loafers, sneakers, Mary Janes, clogs, sandals, heels, and boots for women, men, and kids, alongside totes, crossbody bags, wallets, and backpacks. The company ships to 40+ countries and emphasizes sustainable, seamless-knit manufacturing that reduces waste. Rothy's was surfaced as a portfolio company of Lightspeed Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer retail brand it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface; this profile captures its identity and web presence for the catalog.

providers.name: Studio Moderna
providers.description: Studio Moderna is one of the largest multichannel direct-to-consumer retailers across Central and Eastern Europe, the Middle East, and beyond, founded in 1992 and headquartered in Emmen, Switzerland, with major operations based in Ljubljana, Slovenia. The company reaches consumers through TV direct-response (Top Shop), e-commerce, print catalogs, call centers, and physical retail stores in roughly twenty countries. Its portfolio of house brands spans sleep and home (Dormeo), kitchenware (Delimano), footwear and wellness (Walkmaxx), and health and lifestyle products (Kosmodisk, Rovus, WellNeo). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; the company exposes no public developer or API surface at this time.

providers.name: SuperValu
providers.description: SuperValu was one of the largest grocery retail and wholesale distribution companies in the United States before being acquired by United Natural Foods (UNFI) in 2018 for $2.9 billion. SuperValu operated retail grocery stores under multiple banners and provided wholesale distribution services. The supervalu.com domain now redirects to UNFI's wholesale food distribution platform. Suppliers interact with UNFI/SuperValu distribution through EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and the myUNFI supplier portal.

providers.name: Wonder Brands
providers.description: Wonder Brands is a Latin American digital-first e-commerce company that builds and operates a portfolio of 15+ consumer product brands (including AlebriPets, Tropical Heal, Somos Reyes, Kingsman, KingsHouse, and KingsPort) spanning mattresses and bedroom furniture, sports equipment, home appliances, travel gear, tools, home and garden furniture, pet and baby products, and personal care. Operating an online-first omnichannel model across Uruguay, Mexico, Colombia, and Chile, it fulfills over 2 million annual orders from 25,000+ square meters of warehouse space, backed by proprietary technology for product optimization, marketing, pricing, and demand forecasting. Backed by QED Investors. The company exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDKs at this time.

providers.name: Henkel
providers.description: A German multinational company operating in adhesives, beauty care, and laundry and home care markets. Produces well-known consumer brands alongside industrial adhesive technologies used worldwide. No public developer API or developer portal was located; Henkel operates a Safety Data Sheets product portal at mysds.henkel.com but does not publish open developer APIs.

providers.name: Post Holdings
providers.description: Post Holdings is a consumer packaged goods holding company with businesses in center-of-the-store, refrigerated, foodservice, food ingredient, and convenient nutrition product categories, with a brand portfolio that includes Post Consumer Brands, Bob Evans, Weetabix, and Michael Foods.

providers.name: Cal-Maine Foods
providers.description: Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. is the largest producer and distributor of fresh shell eggs in the United States. The company sells most of its shell eggs to grocery store chains, club stores, foodservice distributors, and egg product consumers across the country and produces specialty eggs including organic, cage-free, free-range, and nutritionally enhanced varieties. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Hanesbrands
providers.description: Hanesbrands is a global consumer apparel company designing, manufacturing, and selling everyday basic apparel under brands including Hanes, Champion, Bali, Maidenform, and Bonds. In 2025 Hanesbrands was acquired by Gildan, with both companies continuing to operate as a combined apparel leader.

providers.name: Newell Brands
providers.description: Newell Brands is a Fortune 500 global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, Parker, Elmer's, Oster, NUK, and Mr. Coffee.

providers.name: Newell Rubbermaid
providers.description: Newell Rubbermaid was a global marketer of consumer and commercial products with brands including Sharpie, Paper Mate, Rubbermaid, and Calphalon before merging with Jarden in 2016 to form Newell Brands.

providers.name: Reckitt Benckiser
providers.description: Reckitt Benckiser is a British multinational consumer-goods company focused on health, hygiene, and nutrition. Its portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Lysol, Dettol, Mucinex, Strepsils, Nurofen, Veet, Finish, Vanish, Air Wick, Calgon, Durex, and Enfamil/Mead Johnson infant nutrition, sold in nearly 200 markets. Reckitt operates as a pure consumer packaged-goods company with retail and e-commerce distribution; it does not publish a public developer API or open partner integration portal at the corporate level. B2B trading-partner connectivity with retailers and distributors is handled via standard EDI / GDSN flows rather than a public REST API.

providers.name: Crocs
providers.description: Crocs, Inc. is a global designer, manufacturer, and retailer of casual footwear known for its iconic molded clog. The company sells through e-commerce, owned retail, and wholesale channels worldwide and also owns the HEYDUDE casual footwear brand. Crocs does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: Flowers Foods
providers.description: Flowers Foods is one of the largest producers and marketers of packaged bakery foods in the United States, with brands including Nature's Own, Wonder, Dave's Killer Bread, Tastykake, and Mrs. Freshley's. No public, developer-facing APIs have been identified for this company; partner and retailer integrations appear to be handled through internal EDI and account-managed channels.

providers.name: Kellanova
providers.description: Kellanova is a global snacks-led consumer packaged foods company, formed in 2023 from the spin-off of the Kellogg Company's snacks, international cereal and noodles, and North American frozen breakfast businesses. Kellanova owns and markets brands including Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, Eggo, RXBAR, MorningStar Farms, and Special K outside North America.

providers.name: Kraft Heinz
providers.description: The Kraft Heinz Company is one of the largest food and beverage companies in the world, producing iconic brands including Kraft, Heinz, Oscar Mayer, Philadelphia, Velveeta, Lunchables, Planters, and Maxwell House. Kraft Heinz does not currently publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Mead Johnson Nutrition
providers.description: Mead Johnson Nutrition was a manufacturer of infant formula and other pediatric nutrition products before being acquired by Reckitt Benckiser in 2017. No public developer APIs are currently documented.

providers.name: MeadWestvaco
providers.description: MeadWestvaco was a global packaging company providing packaging solutions to many of the world's most-admired brands in the personal and beauty care, food, beverage, home and garden, and other industries. In 2015 MeadWestvaco merged with Rock-Tenn to form WestRock, and the MeadWestvaco brand has since been retired. No public APIs or developer resources are documented for the legacy MeadWestvaco entity or for its WestRock successor.

providers.name: Performance Food Group
providers.description: Performance Food Group is one of the largest foodservice distributors in North America, marketing and distributing food and food-related products to independent and chain restaurants and other institutional customers.

providers.name: Vida
providers.description: Vida is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of 500-global, gv, slow-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Unilever
providers.description: A British-Dutch multinational consumer goods company with a portfolio spanning food, personal care, and household brands. Owns over 400 brands including Dove, Ben & Jerry's, Hellmann's, and Vaseline sold in 190 countries.

providers.name: Darling Ingredients
providers.description: Darling Ingredients is a global developer and producer of sustainable natural ingredients from edible and inedible bio-nutrients, creating products for the food, pet food, feed, fuel, bioenergy, and fertilizer industries. Darling operates Diamond Green Diesel as a renewable diesel joint venture with Valero, and brands such as Rousselot (gelatin and collagen), Sonac, CTH, and EnviroFlight. Darling does not publish a public developer API.

providers.name: Essity
providers.description: Essity is a Swedish-headquartered global hygiene and health company operating across four business areas: Health & Medical, Personal Care, Consumer Tissue, and Professional Hygiene. The company is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (ESSITY) and owns roughly 40 brands including TENA (incontinence care), Tork (professional hygiene), Libero (baby diapers), Libresse / Bodyform / Nana / Saba / Nuvenia / Libra (feminine care), Modibodi and Knix (period underwear), JOBST (compression hosiery), Leukoplast (adhesive bandages), Cutimed, Sorbact, Hydrofera and Actimove (wound care, sports medicine, orthopedic supports), Delta-Cast (casting), and consumer tissue brands Lotus, Zewa, Tempo, Cushelle, Plenty, Velvet, Regio, Sorbent and Purex. No public developer-facing APIs or developer portal have been identified for Essity; this repository tracks corporate, brand, sustainability, investor, and integration surfaces for ongoing API discovery. The company's Tork brand ships a connected washroom data platform — Tork Vision Cleaning — which is the closest thing to a public data surface in the portfolio.

providers.name: Molson Coors Beverage
providers.description: Molson Coors Beverage Company is one of the world's largest brewers, with a portfolio of beers and beverages including Coors Light, Miller Lite, Coors Banquet, Blue Moon, Carling, and many others.

providers.name: Mondelez
providers.description: Mondelez International is a Fortune 500 multinational confectionery, food, and beverage company that owns iconic snack brands including Oreo, Cadbury, Milka, Toblerone, Trident, Ritz, and Triscuit.

providers.name: besunyen
providers.description: Besunyen is a Chinese consumer-health company known for herbal weight-management, functional and detox teas plus related wellness and nutrition products, surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment on 2026-07-18 found no public developer, API, or documentation surface — besunyen.com serves only an nginx 404 and its TLS certificate is issued for besunyen.co (hostname mismatch); the only real artifact captured is a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Church and Dwight
providers.description: Church & Dwight Co., Inc. is a Fortune 500 American consumer packaged goods (CPG) company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, that manufactures and markets a portfolio of household, personal care, health and wellness, beauty, and specialty products. Best known as the parent company of the Arm & Hammer baking soda brand (the company's flagship since 1846), Church & Dwight operates through three reporting segments: Consumer Domestic, Consumer International, and Specialty Products Division. The company's brand portfolio includes Arm & Hammer, Trojan, OxiClean, Vitafusion, L'il Critters, Therabreath, Hero (Mighty Patch), Batiste, Waterpik, OraJel, Nair, Spinbrush, First Response, RepHresh, Zicam, Flawless, Toppik, Viviscal, Kaboom, Orange Glo, XTRA laundry detergent, and Arrid antiperspirant. Church & Dwight does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; partner integrations are managed through internal portals, and consumer experiences focus on brand websites, e-commerce direct-to-consumer storefronts, and the Innovation Portal for external R&D partnerships.

providers.description: Estée Lauder Companies is a global manufacturer and marketer of skincare, makeup, fragrance, and hair care products with a portfolio of prestige brands sold worldwide.

providers.description: Ingredion partners with food and beverage manufacturers to deliver innovative clean label, sugar reduction, plant-based proteins, and texture solutions.

providers.name: Kirby
providers.description: For over a century, Kirby has set the standard in high-performance home cleaning. From powerful vacuums to versatile floor care systems, Kirby delivers!

providers.name: Mattel
providers.description: We empower the next generation to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. Check out our top toys from Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher Price and more on Mattel.com!

providers.description: Philip Morris International is a leading international tobacco company offering smoke-free products and combustible tobacco products to adult consumers around the world.
